dataset.name: giantsteps-key
dataset.title: GiantSteps Key, as GiantSteps+ (Faraldo 2017 revision)
dataset.referenceNote: the GiantSteps+ single-key label (keys_gs+), tonic and major/minor
notes: 600 two-minute Beatport previews of electronic dance music. mirdata's giantsteps_key loader is the GiantSteps+ revision of the original GiantSteps Key labels, with the audio published on Zenodo.

Labels with two keys ('E major | E minor'), 'other' modes, 'X' or a misspelt tonic are not scored and are counted as unusable; modal labels keep their major/minor word ('F minor dorian' is scored as F minor).
